OPERATOR RULING (recorded verbatim, attributed to the operator): "Unreadable config should result in an error."

This answers this ticket's one question — do the opt-in verify.* gates keep failing OPEN on an unreadable config? — with NO, and with a posture NEITHER of the two previously argued options: an unreadable/corrupt rebar.toml must raise a loud error that fails the operation, not silently resolve gates to their defaults (fail-open), and not a fail-CLOSED gate that can only answer 'unavailable' (the measured counterfactual in steep-tired-whimbrel's decision comment — zero enforcement bought). The fault surfaces to the operator with the parse error so it gets FIXED, instead of being laundered into either a policy choice or a block nobody can act on.

This ticket therefore becomes an implementation ticket; description will be updated with the design per the plan template.
